parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly identifies that contributions are mentioned in each paragraph (not just the final one), which violates the rubric requirement. This is well-supported by direct quotes from the text and the scoring criterion clearly maps to 0. Rationale B reaches the same score (0) but its reasoning is incorrect—it claims the final paragraph fails to address previous points, when in fact the final paragraph (second paragraph) does address the information-bottleneck prior work discussed in its own preceding paragraph, and the first paragraph's contribution claims address the knowledge distillation prior work in that paragraph. B misidentifies the structural issue (the real problem is that BOTH paragraphs contain contributions, not that the final one fails to connect to prior paragraphs).
